# Checklist — 3D Avatar Platform Requirements

**Purpose:** assess whether platform-foundation requirements are complete, clear, consistent and measurable before implementation.  
**Created:** 2026-08-14  
**Primary source:** `PLATFORM_FOUNDATION_REQUIREMENTS.md`  
**Actor/timing:** platform author and TD/3D/web reviewers before foundation work and after architecture changes.  
**Rule:** checked means the requirement is sufficiently defined, not that the platform implementation passes.
**Machine evidence:** `qa/avatar_36C/platform-requirements-validation.json` generated by `npm run validate:requirements`.  
**Last verified:** 2026-08-14 — 36/36 PFQ plus 3/3 structure checks PASS.

## Requirement completeness

- [x] **PFQ001** Are platform outcome, individual-asset approval and excluded product capabilities explicitly separated? [Completeness, Req §1]
- [x] **PFQ002** Are lifecycle states, transition authority, versioning and evidence invalidation requirements present? [Completeness, Req §2]
- [x] **PFQ003** Are repository boundary, large-binary storage, dependency pinning and clean bootstrap requirements covered? [Completeness, Req §3]
- [x] **PFQ004** Are Blender/MPFB responsibilities and authoring-only data boundaries documented? [Completeness, Req §4]
- [x] **PFQ005** Are skeleton, pose matrix, continuous motion and combined-morph requirements enumerated? [Completeness, Req §5]
- [x] **PFQ006** Are exporter, validator, round-trip and independent viewer gates defined separately? [Completeness, Req §6]
- [x] **PFQ007** Are viewer, automation, deployment, operations and privacy requirements included? [Completeness, Req §7–9]

## Requirement clarity

- [x] **PFQ008** Is “platform ready” distinguished from anatomical, measurement, factory and simulation approval? [Clarity, Req §1, §10]
- [x] **PFQ009** Is the relationship between parent repository and project boundary explicit? [Clarity, Req §3]
- [x] **PFQ010** Is the storage responsibility of Git versus Git LFS stated by artifact type? [Clarity, Req §3]
- [x] **PFQ011** Are “canonical”, “prototype”, “approved master” and “production release” required to have distinct identities? [Clarity, Req §2]
- [x] **PFQ012** Is the minimum rig defined by named bone chains rather than the vague term “human rig”? [Clarity, Req §5]
- [x] **PFQ013** Are motion endpoints and the continuous sweep expressed with numeric arm angles? [Clarity, Req §5]
- [x] **PFQ014** Is Vite adoption tied to a defined multi-module production boundary rather than required for the controlled fixture? [Clarity, Req §7]

## Requirement consistency

- [x] **PFQ015** Does the platform authority hierarchy remain consistent with `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`? [Consistency, Req §2]
- [x] **PFQ016** Are draft-platform exercises consistent with the prohibition on production release before asset approval? [Consistency, Req §1–2, §9]
- [x] **PFQ017** Are runtime coordinate, naming and budget requirements delegated consistently to the existing asset contract? [Consistency, Req §6]
- [x] **PFQ018** Is the prototype-sanitizing export boundary consistent with preserving the canonical GLB? [Consistency, Req §6]
- [x] **PFQ019** Are semantic morph requirements consistent across authoring, export and viewer layers? [Consistency, Req §4–7]
- [x] **PFQ020** Are TD/3D review decisions prevented from being replaced by machine, CI or screenshot results? [Consistency, Req §8]

## Acceptance criteria quality

- [x] **PFQ021** Can every asset/evidence relationship be verified from ID, version, status, revision and SHA? [Measurability, Req §2]
- [x] **PFQ022** Can rig completeness be assessed from the named minimum bone inventory? [Acceptance Criteria, Req §5]
- [x] **PFQ023** Can motion coverage be assessed from the complete named pose matrix and continuous sweep? [Acceptance Criteria, Req §5]
- [x] **PFQ024** Can export completeness be assessed independently for helpers, morphs, skins, animations and extras? [Acceptance Criteria, Req §6]
- [x] **PFQ025** Are local aggregate validation and CI failure conditions objectively stated? [Acceptance Criteria, Req §8]
- [x] **PFQ026** Are deployment readiness and rollback evidence distinguished from successful local preview? [Acceptance Criteria, Req §9]

## Scenario and edge-case coverage

- [x] **PFQ027** Is the response defined when the TD source, required rig/morph/animation or evidence is missing? [Exception, Req §2, §4–8]
- [x] **PFQ028** Is evidence invalidation defined after an asset hash change? [Recovery, Req §2]
- [x] **PFQ029** Is accidental helper/draft-data export addressed as a fail-closed condition? [Edge Case, Req §4, §6]
- [x] **PFQ030** Are desktop/mobile, load/error and missing-feature viewer scenarios covered? [Coverage, Req §7–8]
- [x] **PFQ031** Are preview, production, rollback and asset-recovery flows covered? [Coverage, Req §9]
- [x] **PFQ032** Is collection of measurements or scan data explicitly blocked pending privacy/security design? [Edge Case, Req §9]

## Dependencies and non-functional requirements

- [x] **PFQ033** Is final body rig weighting dependent on TD measurement approval and master freeze? [Dependency, Req §4]
- [x] **PFQ034** Are pinned dependencies and clean bootstrap requirements defined across Node, Python, Blender and MPFB? [Non-functional, Req §3]
- [x] **PFQ035** Are accessibility, responsive framing, performance and offline/local dependency requirements represented? [Non-functional, Req §7]
- [x] **PFQ036** Is CI required to operate within the project boundary instead of assuming a parent workflow applies correctly? [Dependency, Req §8]

**Author assessment:** `36/36 REQUIREMENTS DEFINED — MACHINE TRACEABILITY PASS`
